explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault introduced upstream. The downstream job received needs keyed by demand record ids n06-r01..n06-r08, but evidence_sources keyed record_id as s01..s08. The supplied upstream source shows assemble_provenance constructs evidence_sources with record_id set from source_id, so downstream prioritize cannot match provenance ranks back to coverage record_ids and all upstream_rank values become 0. The downstream prioritize function is consistent with its declared contract to rank by evidence_sources record_id, so the supported localization is the upstream assemble_provenance function.
cited_evidence: job_2 input needs preserve demand record ids such as record_id n06-r01 through n06-r08, while job_2 input evidence_sources has record_id s01 through s08.
Observed job_2 priorities all show upstream_rank: 0, indicating the provenance rank handoff did not match downstream record identities.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index}.

prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id') and looks up rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get('record_id'), 0), which fails when evidence record_id values are s01..s08 and coverage record_id values are n06-r01..n06-r08.
